biggest_catch: This is a whole-home heat-pump project, not a single-room mini-split — partial-home installs get a lower tier, and the incentive is capped at $8,500.
catches: Whole-home tier ($2,650/ton up to $8,500) requires the heat pump to serve the whole home; partial-home installs fall to the $1,125/ton tier.
Massachusetts residential customer of a Mass Save sponsor (National Grid).
Air-to-water whole-home is also $2,650/ton up to $8,500; air-to-water partial is $2,000/ton.
Mass Save does not publish a payout timeline in the rebate sheet — s3 honestly marked false.
The heat-pump installation is a condition, not an upfront fee.
